Blessings, Beachfront 5BR Santa Rosa Beach Vacation Home with Private Pool & Gulf Views

Welcome to Blessings, a stunning 5-bedroom beachfront retreat located along Scenic 30A in Santa Rosa Beach. Boasting private beach access, a sparkling 26’ x 12’ pool, and sweeping Gulf of Mexico views, this luxurious coastal escape is the perfect haven for families and large groups, comfortably accommodating up to 22 guests.

Unbeatable Beachfront Location on 30A

Wake each morning to the gentle sound of waves and breathtaking views of the emerald-green waters right outside your door. Step onto your private beachfront deck with your morning coffee, stroll the sugar-white sands, or take a refreshing dip in your private pool just steps from the shoreline.

Spacious & Stylish Interiors Designed for Comfort

Blessings blends casual coastal style with spacious design, offering plenty of room for everyone to relax and reconnect. The open-concept living area features airy loft ceilings, abundant natural light, and panoramic Gulf views.

Highlights include:

Expansive beachfront deck perfect for sunset cocktails and ocean breezes

Bright, modern kitchen with white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and two large islands—ideal for cooking and entertaining

Dining area with seating for up to 11 guests (8 at the main table + 3 at a breakfast nook)

Cozy living room with a large blue sectional (king sleeper), lounge chairs, and a flat-screen TV

5 Spacious Bedrooms + Additional Sleeping Areas

Perfect for multi-family vacations or group getaways, Blessings offers flexible sleeping arrangements and private ensuite spaces.

First Floor:

King Primary Suite – Beachfront deck access, ensuite bathroom, and stunning Gulf views

Twin Bedroom – Two twin beds with nearby full bath

Bunk Room – Two twin bunk beds with a convenient half bath

Second Floor:

Two Sleeper Sofas – Located in the open loft area overlooking the main living space

Two Guest Bedrooms:

Bedroom 1: Two full-size beds with ensuite bathroom

Bedroom 2: King-size bed with ensuite bathroom

Explore the Best of 30A & Santa Rosa Beach

Blessings sits in a prime location close to top 30A attractions, world-class dining, and coastal entertainment.

Nearby Favorites:

Gulf Place Town Center – Local boutiques, coffee shops, art galleries, and live music

Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar – Famous beachfront restaurant with fresh seafood and Gulf views

Santa Rosa Golf Club – Scenic 18-hole golf course just minutes away

Scenic Highway 30A – Explore charming beach towns, rare coastal dune lakes, and bike-friendly paths

Book Your Ultimate 30A Beachfront Getaway Today!

With panoramic Gulf views, private pool, direct beach access, and proximity to Santa Rosa Beach’s best attractions, Blessings offers everything you need for a luxurious, unforgettable 30A vacation.

Book your stay at Blessings today and experience the perfect blend of coastal comfort, style, and serenity on the Emerald Coast.

Reserve your stay today and experience beachfront bliss on Florida’s Emerald Coast!

POOL HEAT
A $50.00 per day fee is added to reservations booked between October 1st - April 30th for Pool Heat. If you prefer to have an unheated pool, please email or call after booking and the fees will be immediately refunded.
PLEASE NOTE: The pool cannot be heated if it is below 52 degrees or above 80 degrees. As your stay gets closer, we will do our best to keep you informed of the forecast during that time period. We will immediately refund you if conditions do not allow for this.

COMPLIMENTARY BEACH SERVICE
Beach Service is provided seasonally from March 1st - October 31st, weather permitting, and is only offered during regular business hours until 5pm. This service at this property includes 3 umbrellas and 6 beach chairs!

You will find everything you need in the property to make the most of your time on the Emerald Coast. We offer a starter kit of premium, eco-friendly guest amenities including: Shampoo, Conditioner, Body and Face Soap, Toilet Paper, Facial Tissues, Dish Soap, Dishwasher Pods, Laundry Detergent, Paper Towels, Trash Bags, Dish Sponge, Bath Towels, and Bed linens.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
